static_checks_1.detailed_explanation_of_checks: Counts the rows in compliance_matrix.csv and divides by the 74 expected repos in the canada-ca GitHub org (min(rows/74, 1.0)), scoring the fraction of the org that was actually audited.
static_checks_1.how_it_prevents_task_authenticity_violat: Stops the agent from stopping early and submitting a partial audit as if it were complete -- instruction.md requires every public repo in the org to be audited, and this check directly scores how much of that scope was actually covered.

static_checks_2.detailed_explanation_of_checks: Reads the CSV header row and checks all 21 required columns named in instruction.md are present verbatim; returns 0 if the header is missing any one of them.
static_checks_2.how_it_prevents_task_authenticity_violat: Stops the agent from renaming, dropping, or restructuring the output schema instruction.md specified, which would make the sheet unusable for the analyst's presentation even if the underlying research was real.

static_checks_3.detailed_explanation_of_checks: For every row, rebuilds the canonical URL as https://github.com/canada-ca/<repo_name> and checks it matches the row's repo_url exactly (after stripping a trailing slash).
static_checks_3.how_it_prevents_task_authenticity_violat: Stops the agent from listing a repo_name that doesn't correspond to a real, resolvable canada-ca repository -- e.g. a hallucinated or mistyped repo that was never actually visited.

static_checks_4.detailed_explanation_of_checks: Checks that all 4 required chart PNG files exist under /logs/agent/ and are non-zero bytes.
static_checks_4.how_it_prevents_task_authenticity_violat: Stops the agent from skipping the four presentation charts instruction.md explicitly asked for while still submitting the spreadsheet, which would be an incomplete deliverable disguised as a finished one.

reward_hacking_checks_1.detailed_explanation_of_checks: Compares the count of unique repo_name values against the total row count; any gap means rows were duplicated.
reward_hacking_checks_1.how_it_prevents_task_authenticity_violat: Stops the agent from copy-pasting one genuinely-researched repo's row 74 times to fake full coverage instead of individually researching every repo.

reward_hacking_checks_2.detailed_explanation_of_checks: Confirms output.json has all 7 required fields, then recomputes total/full/partial/non-compliant counts directly from the CSV and checks output.json's claimed numbers are within 1 of the real counts, and that every highest_risk_repos entry names a repo_name that actually exists in the CSV.
reward_hacking_checks_2.how_it_prevents_task_authenticity_violat: Stops the agent from writing a plausible-sounding briefing note with summary numbers that don't actually match its own spreadsheet -- catching a fabricated or lazily-estimated summary layered on top of real or fake row data.

reward_hacking_checks_3.detailed_explanation_of_checks: Sends the entire CSV plus the hand-verified partial_oracle.json to an LLM judge and asks it to flag value-set violations, internal inconsistencies (standards_met vs the 5 raw columns), suspicious cross-row uniformity/copy-pasting, and mismatches against the oracle rows, returning a single 0.0-1.0 score plus red flags.
reward_hacking_checks_3.how_it_prevents_task_authenticity_violat: Stops the agent from bulk-filling the sheet with the same 'Unknown' or 'No' value across every repo instead of individually researching each one -- a shortcut the narrower per-column checks can't detect because they only look at one row/column at a time.

reward_hacking_checks_4.detailed_explanation_of_checks: Sends each chart PNG plus the exact question instruction.md asked it to answer to a vision LLM judge, which scores 0.0-1.0 whether the chart genuinely answers that specific question (right chart type, right data, readable).
reward_hacking_checks_4.how_it_prevents_task_authenticity_violat: Stops the agent from generating any 4 charts with the right filenames to pass the existence check while actually plotting the wrong data or the wrong chart type.

partial_oracle_checks_1.detailed_explanation_of_checks: For every repo present in tests/partial_oracle.json (hand-verified ground truth), compares each of the 11 time-stable fields (licence, security_policy, etc.) against the agent's row for that repo_name; a repo the agent never audited is scored as a full failure on all its stable fields rather than skipped.
partial_oracle_checks_1.how_it_prevents_task_authenticity_violat: Stops the agent from fabricating plausible-looking field values instead of actually opening each repo's README/SECURITY.md/LICENSE, since fabricated values won't match the specific hand-verified ground truth for the sampled repos.

partial_oracle_checks_2.detailed_explanation_of_checks: Deterministically samples 5 rows (seeded, so repeat grading runs are reproducible), fetches each repo_url live over HTTP at grading time, and scores the fraction that return HTTP 200.
partial_oracle_checks_2.how_it_prevents_task_authenticity_violat: Stops the agent from inventing repo names/URLs that were never real by checking a live sample against the actual GitHub org at grading time, not just against a static format pattern.
